upstream_note: the declared task upstream 'iclr.com' is a GoDaddy parking lander (a 114-byte redirect to /lander with no content); the real ICLR service this mirror targets is https://iclr.cc/ — the same normalization precedent as the dblp mirror (declared parked dblp.com -> real dblp.org) and the fox_sports mirror (invalid fox_sports.com -> real www.foxsports.com). The task brief's 'entertainment media' domain label is a stale template artifact (disney/fox_sports share the same text); the actual upstream defines the site: the International Conference on Learning Representations.
capture_method: direct HTTP (urllib, Chrome UA) against the public pages of iclr.cc and blog.iclr.cc; no WAF, bot check or login wall was encountered on any public page; every captured page returned HTTP 200 and is stored as the raw body in scraped_data/captures/ with a .meta.json sidecar (url, status, bytes, sha256, UTC timestamp). The accepted-papers dataset (5691 papers with authors, institutions, topics, decisions, sessions, rooms, poster positions, OpenReview links) and the per-paper abstracts come from the upstream's own JSON data files at /static/virtual/data/iclr-2026-orals-posters.json and /static/virtual/data/iclr-2026-abstracts.json, captured verbatim. Event detail pages (invited talks, workshops, socials, town hall, test of time, expo talks, mentorship, breaks, remarks, reception, registration desks) were captured page-by-page from the calendar links. The upstream JSON API (/api/miniconf/*) requires authentication and was not used.
waf_note: None. iclr.cc and blog.iclr.cc serve every public page to plain HTTP with a desktop user agent; no fixture fallback was needed and every record is a live upstream capture.

https://iclr.cc/.role: conference home (defaults to the 2027 edition): 2027 CFP dates, hotel-block notice, venue placeholder, exhibitor blurb

https://iclr.cc/Conferences/2026.role: ICLR 2026 conference home: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, April 23-27 2026; attendee quick links; announcements

https://iclr.cc/Conferences/2027.role: ICLR 2027 (upcoming): The Fifteenth International Conference on Learning Representations, California, April 26-30 2027; CFP/guides/AI policies/pricing/board pages

https://iclr.cc/virtual/2026/*.role: the ICLR 2026 virtual site: getting-started/venue facts, papers page, the six-day Rio calendar (Apr 22-27), workshops/orals/socials/blog-track/journal-track listings, invited-talk bios, awards, sponsor list, organizers, town hall, search

https://iclr.cc/virtual/2026/{kind}/{id}.role: 207 event detail pages parsed from the calendar: 40 workshops (organizers, project pages, abstracts, internal talk schedules), 21 socials, 15 breaks, 12 expo talks/panels, 6 mentorship sessions, 6 registration desks, 2 remarks, 1 reception, 1 test-of-time event, 1 town hall, plus a 40-page deterministic sample of poster detail pages used for fidelity checks

https://iclr.cc/static/virtual/data/iclr.role: the upstream accepted-papers dataset: 5691 papers (5244 Accept (Poster), 447 Accept (Oral)) with per-paper authors and institutions, topic taxonomy, decision, event type, session, room, start/end instants, poster positions and OpenReview forum links
per-paper abstracts keyed by the same event ids

https://blog.iclr.cc/.role: the nine conference announcements the site pages reference: ICLR 2026 Outstanding Papers (2 + 1 honorable mention, with the award committee), Test of Time awards from ICLR 2016 (DCGAN, DDPG), keynotes announcement, review-process retrospective, security-incident response, LLM-generated-papers response, LLM usage policies, ICLR 2027 submission policies

https://iclr.cc/{About,FAQ,FAQ/Cancellat.role: core site pages: About ICLR text, FAQ question/answer sections, contact-HelpDesk form structure, code of conduct, diversity, privacy, journal-to-conference, sponsor/exhibitor info, registration-closed state

media.note: All 37 images under static/images/ are real upstream fetches; every file's exact source URL, byte length and sha256 are recorded in asset_inventory.json and the download manifest maps each to the captured pages that reference it.
media.organizer_portraits: 19 portraits from the exact personal-site URLs the upstream organizers page renders (media.iclr.cc, github.io pages, university pages, i.imgur.com, n-gao.de, colinraffel.com, ...); the two http:// references (imaginarynumber.net, cs.columbia.edu) are fetched over https, which both hosts serve, and the https URL is recorded. Two more upstream portrait URLs were dropped after byte-level verification: www.cs.cornell.edu/~bharathh/me-web.jpg serves a JPEG whose bytes continue 1030 bytes past the EOI marker with a non-image 'SEFT' container trailer (fails the repo's JPEG framing gate), and jyzhao.net/img/jieyuz.jpeg serves an HTML document at the image URL. The mirror renders styled-initial blocks for those organizers instead of shipping broken or non-image assets.
media.blog_artwork: keynote headshots and policy illustrations from blog.iclr.cc/wp-content/uploads
media.upstream_placeholder_note: the upstream serves /static/virtual/img/person_placeholder.svg for speakers/organizers without a photo (e.g. Katherine Bouman); the mirror renders a styled-initial block for those people instead of shipping a placeholder asset

upstream_data_quirks: the orals-posters JSON carries -07:00 timezone labels while the conference ran at UTC-3; the instants are correct (07:42-07:00 == 11:42-03:00) and the mirror renders Rio local times cross-checked against the calendar and session pages

the 2026/2027 pricing pages render literal CMS tokens like 'The date CancellationDeadline not found.' where the live site's date lookup fails; the mirror keeps the captured policy text and never invents prices (the only captured price is the $50 guest banquet ticket)
the calendar keeps a 'Rescheduled to Saturday: Percy Liang' placeholder entry (event 10022468) next to the rescheduled Marin talk (10020867); both are mirrored faithfully
one VerifAI workshop schedule row renders 'Emily McMilin' as both talk title and author; mirrored verbatim
interactive_flows: Accounts (create profile / login / logout), paper bookmarks, personal-schedule saves, the registration form (captured affiliation types, purchasable items with the upstream exclusivity rule, $50 guest banquet tickets, dietary preference) and the HelpDesk contact form are original mirror code seeded with deterministic benchmark fixtures; every paper, event, workshop, sponsor, organizer and news item they reference is a real captured upstream row.
